description:
The Bacchetta Carbon Aero Quattro performance recumbent frameset is a high-performance, racing-oriented bike frame designed by Bacchetta, a leader in recumbent bicycle innovation since 2002. This frameset features advanced carbon fiber construction combined with precision engineering to optimize speed, durability, and handling. The frame includes the main carbon fiber frame, fork, seat mounting hardware, steering riser with headset compression device (BFT), adjustable handlebars, idler, headset, and thru-axles. It is compatible with 142x12mm rear thru-axle and 100x12mm front thru-axle configurations; quick-release wheels are incompatible. The frame is designed for disk brakes, requiring specific adapters for 160mm rotor sizes and post-mount brake options.
Constructed from high-grade carbon fiber, the medium frame weighs approximately 1760 grams, and the large frame weighs approximately 1780 grams, both including seat rail and slider. The geometry supports seat heights of 26 inches (Carbon Fiber), 27 inches (Euromesh), and 28 inches (B3). The bottom bracket shell measures 68mm with English threading. Exterior tire clearance accommodates up to 700c x 50mm rear and front tires on large frames, and up to 700c x 40mm on medium frames. Exseam range varies by size: medium frames fit 39-46 inches with carbon fiber and 40-46 inches with Euromesh/B3, while large frames fit 42.5-49.5 inches (carbon fiber) and 43.5-49.5 inches (Euromesh/B3). The cassette clearance supports up to 52 teeth, and weight capacity is rated at 275 pounds.
Features

Constructed from high-strength carbon fiber for lightweight durability
Includes fork, seat hardware, steering riser with headset compression device, and thru-axles
Compatible with 142x12mm rear thru-axle and 100x12mm front thru-axle; adapters available for other configurations
Designed for disc brakes with internal cable routing and oversized tapered head tube for modern forks
Supports tires up to 700c x 50mm on large frames, and 700c x 40mm on medium frames

Use Cases

Ideal for competitive racing and high-performance recumbent cycling where speed and control are prioritized
Suitable for endurance events, including RAAM-style races, and for recumbent cyclists who require a lightweight, aerodynamically optimized frameset.
Great for riders seeking a versatile recumbent frame compatible with modern disc brakes, with a focus on durability and advanced geometry

Does not include brake adapters, which must be purchased separately based on desired brake setup.
Care

Frame should be cleaned with a damp cloth and mild soap; avoid harsh chemicals
Use appropriate torque when installing components to prevent stress or damage
Warranty details are provided by Bacchetta; contact manufacturer for specific coverage
Inspect for cracks or damage periodically, especially after impacts or crashes
